# ViewClip

**Category:** Render  
**Aliases:** ViewClip

## What it does

Ignores block collision for the camera in third person

Description basis: [publisher description](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/ViewClip.html). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
